Why We Exist

A trend without a significance test is just an opinion.

Everyone sees climate charts in the news. Almost nobody can tell whether a jagged line is real long-term warming or normal summer-and-winter swings.

Trap 1
Seasonal cycles mask real multi-decade drift
Trap 2
Annual summary artifacts (YYYY13) corrupt naive averages
Trap 3
Dashboards hide whether data is live, frozen, or simulated

How the Engine Thinks

Three questions. Zero guesswork.

Every observation series passes through a deterministic statistical pipeline before a single word of interpretation is shown.

1. Is it real?
Seasonal Mann-Kendall (period = 12) + Original MK at alpha = 0.05
2. How much?
Deseasonalized Theil-Sen slope per decade with 95% confidence band
3. Where from?
Hydrometeorology, Fire/Aerosol, Space Weather, and CMR Roadmap

Verified Benchmark · 1984–2025 (n = 504)

Significant warming across all three Brazilian biomes.

Computed deterministically via pymannkendall and scipy.stats.theilslopes over continuous NASA POWER monthly series.

Campinas-SP
+0.409 °C/dec · 95% CI [+0.333, +0.489] · +1.718 °C total (p < 1e-16)
Petrolina-PE
+0.301 °C/dec · 95% CI [+0.231, +0.371] · +1.265 °C total (p = 4.66e-15)
Manaus-AM
+0.307 °C/dec · 95% CI [+0.254, +0.359] · +1.287 °C total (p < 1e-16)
Deterministic stats: pymannkendall (period=12) + scipy.stats.theilslopes (95% CI) Slide 5 / 7
Falsification Inside the Product

One statistical engine. Opposite causal verdicts.

Surface solar brightening can come from fewer clouds or cleaner air. Comparing All-Sky vs Clear-Sky irradiance separates them automatically.

Manaus & Petrolina
Cloud attenuation falls (-0.855 & -0.965 %/dec), while Clear-Sky is null (p = 0.769 / 0.290) -> Cloud-driven.
Campinas-SP
Cloud attenuation is null (p = 0.948), while Clear-Sky rises (+0.190 MJ/m2/day/dec, p < 1e-16) -> Aerosol / clear-sky driven.
Declared Null (WS2M)
Monthly wind speed has no significant trend anywhere (p = 0.489 / 0.173 / 0.451) -> No grid ramp claim.
Scientific honesty: every vector declares live, frozen snapshot, or roadmap status Slide 6 / 7
